verdict.rationale: The axis applies because sevDesk is a SaaS product with a public REST API, so it could plausibly publish llms.txt or agent-oriented docs. The probes found no llms.txt (HTTP 404) and no markdown docs variant (HTTP 404). The published OpenAPI YAML and Redoc reference are conventional developer documentation, not agent-oriented docs, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
